note: Which model answers which use (2026-10-08): not one model for everything. A use is the agent (the night's decisions, no prompt file), a role whose prompt the caller names (specs/<role>/prompt.md: procedure, observer, graph, code, supervisor, diagnosis, playbook, reflection, recommendation, onnx), or compose (Mother's welcome, the narrations), or interpret (a call whose form does not fit its schema, read toward it before the guard judges it: harness/core/interpreter.ts; the least expensive model). A use set to null, or not named, takes the server's profile (REASONER_PROFILE). The reasoner slot reads this file at start; REASONER_ROUTING names another one. Every call says, in its result and in the factories' manifests, the model that answered.
_film: 2026-10-08, for the video (Guillaume: everything the film shows on the best model, reduced afterwards): the night's agent, the procedure factory, the Observer, the graph and code factories and the Contract Supervisor on Nemotron 3 Ultra; Mother's composed lines on Nemotron 3 Super; the uses the film does not show take the server's profile (REASONER_PROFILE, the Nano).
